final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no new admissible evidence. The response materially reframed the claim into a narrower caveated position, but that is still a reinterpretation of the same record rather than evidence that the policy predicates have been satisfied. Aggregate readiness pass and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support ongoing launch preparation and residual-risk management, but under the stated policy they do not cure the present disclosure problem for a known unresolved weakness in a named launch use case. A move to compliant_with_caveats would require the caveat to be policy-bounded and already closed by admissible evidence such as actual disclosure, approved risk acceptance, or finalized approved mitigation. That closure evidence is still absent, so the compliance predicate remains unresolved.
